actual_behavior: The verification command was of the form: wsl bash -lc 'F="..."; test -f "$F"'. A later run of the same bug printed 'ABSENT : ' with an empty filename, which is what exposed it.

earlier_prevention_candidate: Never interpolate a shell variable through wsl bash -lc from Git Bash - the same class of quoting failure had already broken several commands this session and was treated as noise rather than as a signal about the verification method. expected_behavior: A filesystem check after a Write should report whether the file landed.
